title: nbinlineai
description: AI prompt cell settings for response style, model, and tool steps. API keys are configured privately through Configure AI or the Jupyter server environment; they are never saved in notebooks.

backendModels.title: Model for each API provider (blank uses server default)

promptMode.title: Response style
promptMode.description: User fallback for notebooks and cells without a style override. Compact is succinct, Full gives detailed explanations and code, and Learning guides with questions and at most three lines of code without full solutions.

promptInstructions.title: Custom response instructions
promptInstructions.description: Optional per-style instructions; blank uses the server default. Maximum 8000 characters per style.
